verdict.rationale: cubic documents a dedicated memory-and-learning feature. It learns your team's unwritten rules from direct feedback on its comments and from patterns in senior engineers' historical code reviews, remembers replies "for next time," and calibrates on thumbs up/down reactions. Explicit conventions can also be supplied through context files like AGENTS.md and through custom agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that learned memory actually persists and is applied to later PRs, and documentation on how to view, edit or scope the stored memory.
